findings.summary: A resumed bound run whose definition disappeared or changed version got unrestricted tools (allowed None); an excluded read reached the provider and an excluded write reached approval. Fixed: the admitted definition is snapshotted in the continuation and used for the whole run; a bound run without a snapshot gets an empty tool set.
ACCEPTANCE_UNMET recorded no acceptance finding (ADR 0028). Fixed: KERNEL-ACCEPTANCE finding with a fixed message in the terminal batch, live and recovery.
